QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Why Did the King Change?
QuestInfo.0: You investigate the Lion King's Castle with J from the Resistance. Talk to the Lion King's queen #bIfia#k in #b#m211061001##k.
QuestInfo.1: Why did Von Leon change like this? Why did he choose to become the Black Mage's Commander? #bLuden#k the knight should know. Go see him in #b#m211060800##k.
QuestInfo.2: The only thing Von Leon wanted for his kingdom was to maintain peace. Hence, he refused to cooperate and get involved with the Alliance and, as a result, lost his kingdom. Furious, he sacrificed his soul to the Black Mage and swore to seek revenge on the Alliance.

0.0: What made him change like this? I don't know... To tell you the truth, I don't remember much about those dark times.
0.1: Every time I try, I see flames and hear screams... It seems I've blocked out some bad memories.
0.2: Luden should remember the details of that time, though. Please give Luden my thanks for remembering what I cannot.

yes.0: I'll stay here with Leon... Even if he's believed that he's alone for hundreds years, I still...
yes.1: I know he's done horrible things, but I will shoulder that weight with him. If I don't who will?
